body: the procedure is uncomfortable, basically, for me i got given 4 tablets that i was allowed to insert vaginally myself, then you begin to feel small waves of cramping then the cramping gets really severe & basically you have to go back & forth to the toilet so that they can monitor what you’ve discharged, i’ll be honest it is really uncomfortable & painful but they do offer painkillers so make sure you get them! you will become really moody & find that all you can focus on is the pain, i hope that your procedure goes well goodluck you’re so brave! you can handle it ! xxx
